proves.claim: boardJobQueueCall in pull mode runs settleDoneShardGates on a board's first claim, skips it for a claim less than SETTLE_WINDOW_MS later, and runs it again once the window has passed.

api.io-gate.settle-throttle-window.why: Without this test the settle walk could run on every pull claim again and cost the serve process about half a second of CPU per request, or never run again and strand a gate whose last apply was lost.

proves.claim: A receipt posted through boardJobQueueCall reopens the settle window, so the next pull claim settles a gate that became eligible inside the window of an earlier settle.

api.io-gate.settle-on-receipt.why: Without this test a throttled settle could hold a finished gate for a whole window after the receipt that finished it.
